Steel building contractors in Barrie using heavier gauge Steel studs are used in load-bearing walls and structural applications such as exterior walls. Lighter gauge Steel studs are used in non-load bearing applications such as some interior walls, half-walls, and partitions. Steel framing tend to be lighter, stronger, and easier to transport.
